方芸背过身去，语气里带着不耐烦：“你给他发私信问问呗！”

许默似笑非笑的开口。

“最近没口腔溃疡吧？”

方芸猛地扭回头，先是不解，随后猛然惊醒，一巴掌拍开他的手，耳朵尖却红了一片。

第二天早上，许默是被系统提示音吵醒的。

成了！

【方芸的营地】

【品质：蓝色（隐藏地貌加成）】

【等阶：3级】

【耐久：2000/2000】

【升级材料：2级石芯×10，1级石材×10000】

【维护消耗：石窟需要能源运转。当前能源：130/5500】

【特性·石灵庇佑：身处其中时，体力值和健康值恢复速度+10/小时，理智值恢复+4/小时，锻造成功率+6%】

许默兴奋的起身。

“三级了。”

“体力恢复加十，理智恢复加四，锻造成功率加百分之六！”

方芸凑过来看了一眼：“这……这比之前强了不止一档。咱们这等级，应该遥遥领先了吧？”

许默点头。

估计其他幸存者还在为吃饱和住得安稳发愁，他们已经在享受三级营地的属性加成了。

他二话不说，走到工作台前，点开升级界面，把积攒的材料一股脑塞了进去。

【工作台升级中，剩余时间：4小时。】

“还有四个小时。”

许默看了一眼倒计时，然后转过身。

“别赖着了，收拾东西，趁这个时间出去转转。”

方芸被掀了被子，冷风灌进来，气得抬脚踢他小腿。

许默躲开了，目光却落在了壁炉灰烬上。

灰白色的草木灰深处，有一点暗红色的光芒在闪烁。

他蹲下来，用铁钳拨开灰烬，一颗暗红色的珠子静静躺在开裂的砖缝里，表面流转着暴躁的能量波纹，通红滚烫。

系统提示跳了出来：

【获得：火铜精华（蓝色）】

【特性：可用于武器附魔“灼烧”】

Fang Yun turned her back and said impatiently: "Send him a private message and ask!"

Xu Mo said with a half-smile.

"You haven't had any oral ulcers lately, have you?"

Fang Yun turned her head suddenly, confused at first, then suddenly woke up, and slapped his hand away, but the tips of her ears turned red.

The next morning, Xu Mo was woken up by the system prompt.

Done!

【Fang Yun's Camp】

[Quality: blue (hidden landform bonus)]

[Level: Level 3]

[Durability: 2000/2000]

[Upgrade materials: Level 2 stone core × 10, Level 1 stone × 10000]

[Maintenance consumption: The grotto requires energy to operate.Current energy: 130/5500]

[Characteristics: Stone Spirit Blessing: When you are in it, the physical and health recovery speed is +10/hour, the sanity recovery rate is +4/hour, and the forging efficiency is +6%]

Xu Mo stood up excitedly.

"It's level three."

"Physical recovery increases by ten, sanity recovery increases by four, and forging efficiency increases by six percent!"

Fang Yun came over and took a look: "This... this is more than one level better than before. Our level should be far ahead, right?"

Xu Mo nodded.

It is estimated that other survivors are still worried about food, clothing and shelter. They are already enjoying the attribute bonus of the third-level camp.

Without saying a word, he walked to the workbench, clicked on the upgrade interface, and stuffed the accumulated materials into it.

[The workbench is being upgraded, remaining time: 4 hours.】

"Four more hours."

Xu Mo glanced at the countdown and then turned around.

"Don't wait, pack your things, and take this time to go out for a walk."

Fang Yun was lifted off the quilt, and the cold wind rushed in. She was so angry that she kicked his calf.

Xu Mo avoided it, but his eyes fell on the ashes of the fireplace.

Deep in the gray grass and gray, there is a little dark red light flickering.

He squatted down and used iron pliers to push away the ashes. A dark red bead lay quietly in the cracked brick crack, with violent energy ripples flowing on the surface, red and hot.

The system prompt pops up:

[Obtain: Fire Bronze Essence (Blue)]

[Features: Can be used for weapon enchantment "burning"]
